# Adopters

This project welcomes voluntary reports of production, evaluation and
development use. No consented deployment reports have been recorded yet.
An empty list does not imply zero users or production readiness.

## Deployment reports

| Adopter | Version | Deployment type | Relationship | Count (unit) | Since date | Evidence | Verified date | Consent |
|---------|---------|-----------------|--------------|--------------|------------|----------|---------------|---------|

## Add, update or remove a report

Open a PR or issue in this project's tracker. Supply the fields above using
[the infrastructure reporting contract](https://github.com/tuna-os/tunaos/blob/main/docs/INFRA-ADOPTION-FRAMEWORK.md#adoptersmd-contract).
Use `unknown` for unavailable counts/dates. Identify internal dogfooding
explicitly. Provide a deployed tag/commit and public evidence, and confirm
permission to list the adopter. Do not include private operator details.
Request corrections or removal through the same tracker.

## Operator guidance

Before publishing this template, replace this paragraph with links to this
project's evaluation setup, version discovery, upgrade/recovery procedures,
known limitations and support channel. Keep readiness claims tied to evidence.
